concerns.text: FR-005 requires training Logistic Regression AND Random Forest. T022 covers Logistic Regression, but T023 (Random Forest) is marked [ ] (unimplemented). There is no task covering the Random Forest training logic required by FR-005 and US-2.

FR-005 requires reporting mean ROC-AUC and F1-score with standard deviation. T024 covers aggregation, but it depends on T023 (Random Forest) and T022 (Logistic Regression). Since T023 is missing, the requirement to report metrics for the Random Forest model is unmet.
FR-007 requires extracting feature importance from the Random Forest model. T029 attempts this, but it depends on T023 (training the Random Forest). Without T023, FR-007 cannot be satisfied.

FR-006 requires a Paired Permutation Test comparing 'Full Metric Set' vs 'Single Best Metric'. T031 covers the test, but T023a (Full Metric Set model) and T027 (Single Best Metric model) are both marked [ ] (unimplemented). The inputs for the test are missing.

US-3 requires generating a final report with feature importance and p-values. T035 compiles the report, but it depends on T032 (feature importance) and T033 (statistical significance), which in turn depend on the unimplemented modeling tasks (T023, T023a, T027).

FR-002 requires calculating Cyclomatic Complexity, Halstead Volume, and LOC. T014 covers LOC, T014b covers CC, and T014c covers Halstead. However, T014b and T014c are marked [ ] (unimplemented). The requirement to calculate CC and Halstead is not covered by completed tasks.
FR-003 requires labeling files as buggy/clean. T015 covers this logic but is marked [ ] (unimplemented). The requirement to generate the 'is_buggy' label is not covered by completed tasks.

FR-001 requires generating a features.csv with no nulls. T017 generates the CSV, but T018 (NaN validation) is marked [ ] (unimplemented). While T017 exists, the specific requirement to ensure 'no nulls' (FR-001/US-1 acceptance) relies on the unimplemented T018.

T000a and T000b reference 'AMEND-001-STATS' and 'Constitution Principle VI'. While the plan mentions this blocker, the tasks themselves are marked [ ] (unimplemented). The plan states execution is BLOCKED until this is resolved, yet the tasks to resolve it are not marked as done, creating a logical gap in the 'tasked' state where the blocker remains active.
